_description: Phishing kits, Adversary-in-the-Middle (AitM) panels, SMTP/letter sender services, smishing infrastructure, and typosquat domain chatter. Distinguished from malware-raas pack (which covers payloads); this pack focuses on credential-harvesting delivery infrastructure.

rules._description: Phishing kit / scampage commercial chatter. Two-signal lookahead: kit/page/panel term + commercial context.
rules._fp_risk: Low-medium. Excludes catch defender / research framing.
rules._severity_rationale: High - phishing kits underpin a large share of credential-theft activity.
rules.name: Phishing - kit / scampage sale

rules._description: Adversary-in-the-Middle (AitM) panel sales - EvilGinx, Tycoon 2FA, Storm-1011 / Evilproxy / Mamba 2FA / Rockstar 2FA / Greatness. These bypass MFA by relaying real-time sessions.
rules._fp_risk: Low. AitM panel names are distinctive jargon.
rules._severity_rationale: Critical - AitM kits bypass MFA, the most impactful evolution in credential-theft tooling.
rules.name: Phishing - AitM / MFA-bypass panel

rules._description: Letter sender / SMTP / inbox-delivery services for phishing campaigns. Two-signal lookahead: SMTP/sender/inbox-tooling term + commercial context.
rules._fp_risk: Low-medium. Email marketing platforms use similar language; excludes pin obvious commercial-platform framing.
rules._severity_rationale: High - bulk inbox delivery is the bottleneck for phishing campaigns.
rules.name: Phishing - letter sender / SMTP service

rules._description: SMS smishing infrastructure - smishing kits, bulk SMS gateways, lookup of carriers / SS7 chatter. Two-signal lookahead: smishing/SMS-attack term + commercial context.
rules._fp_risk: Low. Smishing kits are distinctive jargon.
rules._severity_rationale: High - smishing has become a major attack vector, especially in banking fraud.
rules.name: Phishing - smishing / SMS infrastructure

rules._description: Typosquat / lookalike domain registration chatter - discussion of newly registered phishing domains targeting specific brands. Two-signal lookahead: typosquat/lookalike/homograph term + actionable framing (just registered, available, drop, sale).
rules._fp_risk: Medium. Domain-research and brand-protection vendors use similar language; excludes pin research framing.
rules._severity_rationale: Medium-high - typosquat registration is an early indicator of campaign preparation.
rules.name: Phishing - typosquat / lookalike domain
